subject: general
question: Which of the following methods is used to calculate national income by summing up the total incomes earned by individuals and businesses in an economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Income method**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Income method** is used to **calculate national income by summing up the total incomes earned by individuals and businesses** in an economy.
 
• This method considers the incomes earned by various factors of production, including wages, rents, interests, and profits.
 
• It provides a comprehensive view of the income distribution within the economy.
 
• The Income method helps in understanding the economic performance and the contribution of different sectors to the national income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other methods to calculate national income include the **Value-added method**, the **Output method**, and the **Expenditure method**.
 
• The **Value-added method** calculates national income by adding the value added at each stage of production.
 
• The **Output method** calculates national income by measuring the total output produced within the economy.
 
• The **Expenditure method** calculates national income by summing up total expenditures made in the economy.
 
• Each method provides a different perspective on the economic activities and helps in cross-verification of the national income estimates.
